tasks.brief:
Implementation constraints: stdlib only (json, os, tempfile, logging). No external dependencies. Read TESTCHAT_DATA env var at call time, not import time. Default to 'data/threads.json'.

Behavioral specification: Create src/services/storage.py with two functions:
1. load_snapshot() -> list[dict]: Read TESTCHAT_DATA env var. If file missing, unreadable, or invalid JSON, return [] (log warning for corrupt). Otherwise return parsed JSON list.
2. save_snapshot(threads: list[dict]) -> None: Read TESTCHAT_DATA env var. Ensure parent directory exists. Write to temp file in same directory, then os.replace() onto target for atomicity.

Acceptance condition: load_snapshot() returns [] for missing/corrupt files, save_snapshot() creates atomic writes.

Implementation constraints: FastAPI, pydantic. Depends on src.services.storage. No external dependencies beyond existing stack.

Behavioral specification: Create src/api/threads.py with:
1. Pydantic models: ThreadSnapshot {id: int, title: str, messages: list[{role, content}], model: str = '', locked: bool = False} and ThreadsPayload {threads: list[ThreadSnapshot]}.
2. APIRouter with routes:
   - GET /api/v1/threads -> {"threads": load_snapshot()} (200 always)
   - PUT /api/v1/threads body ThreadsPayload -> save_snapshot(payload as plain dicts) -> {"status": "ok"}
   - DELETE /api/v1/threads -> save_snapshot([]) -> {"status": "ok"}

Acceptance condition: Router mounts correctly, routes return expected status codes and data.

Implementation constraints: Edit existing src/main.py. Add defensive try/except import block for src.api.threads, identical in shape to chat/models blocks.

Behavioral specification: In src/main.py, add import block for src.api.threads router. Mount the router to the FastAPI app. Ensure it's additive and doesn't break existing routes.

Acceptance condition: All existing tests pass, new threads routes accessible. Tests that import src.main must pass after this task.

Implementation constraints: Edit existing src/static/app.js. Four small anchored edits. Persistence must never break chat (.catch swallowed).

Behavioral specification: In src/static/app.js:
1. Add persistThreads() helper: fetch PUT /api/v1/threads with JSON.stringify({threads: threads.map(t => ({id: t.id, title: t.title, messages: t.messages, model: t.model || '', locked: !!t.locked}))}), fire-and-forget.
2. Replace bare createThread() bootstrap with fetch GET /api/v1/threads: on non-empty threads array, rebuild state (threads = data.threads with messages/model/locked; threadCounter = max id; activeThreadId = first thread's id; renderThreadMessages + restoreThreadModelState + renderSidebar); on empty array OR fetch error, fall back to createThread().
3. Call persistThreads() in 'done' event handler, immediately after two messages are pushed.
4. Call persistThreads() at end of createThread().

Acceptance condition: UI tests pass, threads survive reload. All UI node-ids must pass after this task.
